prompt: Theme: Photorealistic editorial portrait. Standing Japanese adult woman in her twenties in an urban setting. Subject: Waist-up, shoulder-level, front-left three-quarter view. The woman stands outdoors in a sunny urban setting, with her full bust, narrow defined waist, and rounded hips clearly visible. Person and expression: Her dark brown hair is neatly tied back in a ponytail, with a few loose strands framing her face. Her face features a well-defined jawline, almond-shaped eyes, arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and soft pink lips. Her expression is serene, with slightly raised eyebrows, wide eyes focused directly at the camera, gently closed lips, and a calm demeanor. Clothing and pose: She wears a crisp white button-down shirt with a navy blue tie loosely draped over her shoulders. A dark backpack strap rests on her right shoulder. Her left arm hangs relaxed by her side, while her right arm is bent at the elbow, the hand resting lightly on the backpack strap. Her body is turned three-quarters toward the camera, her head tilted slightly to meet the viewer’s gaze. Background and light: Kabukicho street corner, casting soft shadows. The light comes from above, creating warm color temperature with soft highlights on her clothing and skin. Composition and camera: Shot on a 50mm standard lens. The framing captures her from the waist up. The camera is positioned at shoulder-level, providing a front-left three-quarter view of her body. Texture and style: A photorealistic image with lifted midtones, creamy pale highlights, and warm peach skin-tone protection. Real human skin with visible pores and fine texture, true-to-life colors, and natural depth of field. Negative: Do not distort the number of fingers on her hands. Do not create asymmetry between her left and right sides. Make it look like a natural everyday photo taken with a smartphone. Avoid excessive skin smoothing or CGI-like texture. Leave slightly visible pores, fine facial hair, slight redness, and natural shadows. Do not make the face perfectly symmetrical. Do not uniformly smooth the hair; leave loose strands and small irregularities. Use of reference image: image 1 is this woman’s character reference sheet. Make the face, facial features, hairstyle, and body type exactly the same person as image 1. Keep the clothing, pose, background, and light as written above. lit only by soft diffused daylight under an overcast sky, the light arriving from one side and wrapping gently around her, no hard-edged shadow anywhere in the frame. shot on an 85mm lens wide open so the depth of field is thin, with real distance between her and what is behind her and that background falling away into soft unreadable shapes; recorded on warm portrait negative film — muted unexcited colour that never goes vivid, the blacks sitting a little above true black, a fine even grain over the whole frame, and the brightest edges bleeding just slightly into what surround

promptZh: 主题：照片级真实感的纪实人像。一位 日本成年女性 二十多岁，置身于城市环境中。主体：半身像，肩部水平，左前方四分之三侧面视角。女性站在阳光明媚的城市户外，胸部丰满，腰部纤细，臀部圆润，轮廓清晰可见。人物与表情：深棕色头发整齐地扎成马尾，几缕碎发散落在脸颊旁。面部轮廓分明，拥有杏仁眼、柳叶眉、挺拔的鼻梁和柔和的粉色嘴唇。表情宁静，眉毛微挑，双眼睁大直视镜头，嘴唇轻闭，神态从容。服装与姿势：她穿着一件 挺括的白色衬衫，系着海军蓝领带，随意地披在肩上。右肩背着深色背包带。左臂自然下垂，右臂肘部弯曲，手轻轻搭在背包带上。身体向镜头转动四分之三，头部微倾，迎向观众的目光。背景与光影：歌舞伎町街角，投下柔和的阴影。光线从上方照射，营造出温暖的色温，并在衣物和皮肤上留下柔和的高光。构图与摄影：使用 50mm 标准镜头拍摄。取景范围为腰部以上。相机置于肩部高度，呈现出主体左前方四分之三的视角。质感与风格：照片级真实感图像，提升中间调，呈现奶油般的浅色高光，并保护温暖的桃色肤色。真实的皮肤质感，可见毛孔和细腻纹理，色彩真实，具有自然的景深。负面提示：不要扭曲手指数量。不要造成左右两侧不对称。使其看起来像是一张用智能手机拍摄的自然日常照片。避免过度磨皮或 CGI 质感。保留轻微可见的毛孔、细小的面部绒毛、轻微的红晕和自然阴影。不要让脸部完全对称。不要统一平滑头发；保留散乱的发丝和小瑕疵。参考图使用：图 1 为该女性的角色参考图。确保脸部、五官、发型和体型与图 1 中的人物完全一致。保持上述服装、姿势、背景和光影设置。仅由阴天下的柔和漫射日光照明，光线从一侧射入并柔和地包裹主体，画面中没有任何硬边缘阴影。使用 85mm 镜头大光圈拍摄，景深较浅，主体与背景之间有真实的距离，背景虚化为柔和模糊的形状；采用温暖的人像负片风格记录——色彩柔和内敛，不追求鲜艳，黑色略高于纯黑，画面覆盖均匀的细颗粒感，最亮边缘略微向周围溢出。
